personality_one_liner: A high-density, performance-oriented command center designed for live operational scanning and tactical wealth management.

spacing.rule: High density rules: tighter margins (sm/md), exposed system states, and structured dividers. Empty space should feel deliberate, not sparse.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a tactical, Dark-First Utility app.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level command center showing Net Worth, FIRE progress, and asset allocation.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks for the Portfolio Hero, Donut Chart, and Area Chart.
states.empty: No assets to display. Shows 'Tambah Aset Pertama' CTA in the center.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Portfolio Hero at the top (Net worth in IDR, day-change chip, FIRE progress %), supported by an allocation donut chart (Cash/Reksadana/ID Stocks/USD Stocks/Gold) and a Net Worth area chart (monthly/yearly toggle). BTC cycle signal banner below the chart. Review reminder banner on the 25th of the month. Use hairline dividers between sections.

screens.name: Audit
screens.purpose: Detailed breakdown of all assets with a Bulk Price Updater and individual ticker management.

states.loading: Skeleton rows representing asset categories and tickers.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty vault. 'Belum ada aset terdaftar.' with a primary Add CTA.
states.error: Unable to fetch asset ledger. Retry button.

screens.layout: Accordion list of 5 asset categories. Each row shows Ticker, Qty, Avg Price, Current Price, Market Value, and Floating P/L (color-coded Emerald/Red). Includes a sticky 'Bulk Price Updater' modal button and '+ Tambah Aset Baru' FAB/Sticky Bottom Action. Ticker detail page includes split Jual/Sell action blocks and a transaction log.

screens.name: Decision Engine
screens.purpose: A tool to calculate and distribute monthly allocation across the portfolio.

states.empty: Standard form view ready for input.

screens.layout: Dense form layout. Top block: Monthly allocation + bonus input. Middle block: Multi-asset allocation rows with two-way % <-> Rp sync. Bottom block: Sticky 'Simpan / Save' button, disabled unless the total exactly matches 100%.

screens.name: JournalLedger
screens.purpose: Chronological ledger of all transactions and thesis notes.

screens.layout: Split view or toggleable tabs between 'Transactions' and 'Thesis Notes'. Transactions view uses a dense watchlist blotter format (Date, Ticker, Type, Amount). Thesis notes view shows a stacked card list of notes.

screens.name: PlaybookSettings
screens.purpose: Strategic trackers, calculators, and system configuration.
screens.layout: List-based settings layout. Sections for: 'Strategy' (BTC 4-year halving tracker 2024–2034 with visual timeline, FIRE Monte Carlo 3-scenario calculator), 'System' (Backup/Restore JSON, PIN lock toggle, USD/IDR rate input), and 'Danger Zone' (Reset app). Ensure touch-friendly tap targets.

screens.name: SetupWizard
screens.purpose: Initial onboarding to configure the user's base operating parameters.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract background with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Step-by-step wizard capturing initial balance, target FIRE number, and preferred base currency. Minimalist, focused inputs with a sticky 'Next' CTA at the bottom.

journal_empty.alt: Empty open notebook on a minimal desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'PIOS' as a 100% offline app with no backend; all state strictly handled locally. Incorporate backup/restore functionality using local JSON.

The default appearance must be Dark mode ('7 Dark-First Utility' theme). Support Light mode by inverting the surface colors to Stark White/Light Grays while maintaining the crisp, tactical density (avoid muddy grays).
Use tabular lining for numbers/metrics. Font pairing is 'Barlow Condensed' for data/headers and 'IBM Plex Sans' for interface labels.
The 'Dashboard' needs to be dense but scannable. Utilize Watchlist Blotters (pairing tickers with live sparkline and color-coded delta chips).
The 'Audit' screen is crucial: construct an accordion list grouping 5 asset categories. Emphasize the 'Bulk Price Updater' and individual ticker detail views.
Decision Engine: The 100% validation check on the allocation form is mandatory; disable the 'Save' CTA until the exact total is reached.
NO BLUES allowed anywhere in the app (including Info states). Rely on Emerald/Mint for positive actions/wealth, Warning for alerts, and Error for negative metrics.
Implement PIN lock functionality natively in the Settings tab.
